routes.notes: A clean Playwright run proved that complete product pages can be returned before subsequent requests are blocked. Successful HTML is preserved for auditable offline parsing; this route is also useful for occasional GTIN/image enrichment when it succeeds.

Official Carrefour product/category pages can be retrieved through an indexed retrieval layer even while direct GitHub-runner HTTP is challenged. Only facts present on the official Carrefour page are persisted. Price/availability from this route are observed Carrefour values but are not asserted as live/current because crawl lag is possible. Exact cumulative counts are maintained in the cumulative summary rather than duplicated here.

routes.notes: Indexed retrieval exposes official Act for Food Carrefour product and category pages despite direct runner WAF blocking. Product pages observed on 2026-08-20 exposed retailer SKU, name, price, unit price and detailed fresh-food attributes such as species, farming zone, cut and state; indexed category pages exposed broad assortment and recent observed listing prices. Only rendered official Carrefour facts are persisted, with crawl-lag metadata.

provenance_rules: Only fields actually observed on a Carrefour-controlled host may use source=CARREFOUR_FIRST_PARTY.
RadarSuper may seed candidate identities or URLs but its fields are never copied into Carrefour first-party evidence.
Open Food Facts data remains OPEN_FOOD_FACTS_VIA_RADARSUPER or its own source and is never relabelled as Carrefour-declared.
Rumbo nutritional or culinary classification is separate from retailer evidence and is not performed in these extraction datasets.
Indexed official-page retrieval is accepted as first-party evidence only for fields actually rendered from the official Carrefour page; its freshness is explicitly qualified.
next_safe_step: Continue low-volume, diverse first-party capture through indexed official Carrefour and Act for Food product/category pages, preserving crawl-lag metadata. Prefer Act for Food indexed pages when they expose fresher assortment or fresh-food attributes. Use clean low-concurrency Playwright opportunistically to capture GTIN/image and saved HTML when the WAF allows it. Do not distribute requests across runners to evade blocking.
